literal_meaning: ঘুমানো অবস্থায় থাকা (sleeping state of being)
figurative_meaning_en: To be unaware, lazy, or careless; not paying attention to surroundings
example_sentences_in_bangla: বিপদ সামনে এসেছে, এখন ঘুমিয়ে থাকার সময় নয়।
সে সবসময় ঘুমিয়ে থাকে, কোনো কাজেই মন দিবে না।
example_sentences_in_english: Danger is approaching; this is no time to be asleep at the wheel.
He always sleeps on the job and never pays attention to anything.
note: This idiom emphasizes vigilance in everyday Bengali expressions, often used metaphorically for alertness in potential risks.
